scientific_integrity: An explicit characteristic-free proof yields the eight ideal-orbit decomposition. Exhaustive q=2,3 checks independently corroborate the counts, but they are not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the free class-two rank-three Lie algebra is classified; higher rank, higher class, and finite-index integral lattices remain outside scope. Related broad ideal-count literature exists. A relevant automorphism paper was accessible as abstract only, leaving residual bibliographic overlap risk. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Eight ideal orbits in the rank-three free class-two nilpotent Lie algebra over finite fields
